patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background colors, often containing content within a centered, fixed-width container. Asymmetrical image grids are used for showcasing work.
A blend of technical monospace fonts (for numbering and code-like elements) and bold, wide, geometric sans-serifs for display headings and navigation, often in uppercase.
A warm, earthy palette featuring light beige, dark maroon, and deep brown, contrasted with black and white text, and punctuated by bright yellow/orange accents.

The hero section features a prominent, interactive 3D WebGL sphere that scrolls out of view. The navigation bar is sticky and transforms its background color from transparent/light to a solid dark maroon upon scroll. Subsequent content sections appear to reveal sequentially as the user scrolls down the page.
Course listings are presented as numbered items within distinct, full-width background blocks, using a monospace font for the numbering.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes WebGL/canvas for a complex, interactive 3D animated sphere that serves as the primary visual element. This element is designed to scroll out of view, revealing the main content.

GSAP ScrollTrigger is employed to manage scroll-based animations, including the sticky navigation's background color and style transformation, and the sequential reveal of content sections as they enter the viewport, likely with a fade-in or subtle slide-up effect.
The site uses a combination of custom fonts, including monospace for functional elements and stylized display fonts for headings, to create a distinct visual identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, wide, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body) are used for section titles and navigation, often paired with smaller, functional monospace or sans-serif text for details and listings.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant for most elements, including buttons, cards, and section boundaries, with only very subtle rounding on a few specific interactive elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy hero and section breaks providing clear visual separation, while content within sections like course listings can be more compact.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a highly interactive, abstract 3D WebGL sphere as its primary hero element, combined with a unique blend of technical monospace and bold, wide display typography, sets it apart. The warm, earthy color palette further enhances this sophisticated yet playful aesthetic, creating a memorable and engaging experience for a technical subject.
